text:
zoe: Quick sync — vendor pen-test intake for next month. Scope: auth layer, inference nodes, and telemetry ingestion. Need agreement on: 1) evidence escrow path, 2) RBAC capture method, 3) temporary bastion access, 4) KMS decrypt pattern, and 5) retest slotting.
peter: I'll own the triage board and retest scheduling. Proposal for retest gating: no open criticals; any high must have either a patch or a documented mitigation + scheduled fix within 5 working days. Medium/low go into backlog.
asif: For evidence escrow: create a timeboxed S3 bucket `escrow-vuln-4123456780` with SSE-KMS (alias/escrow-412345) and lifecycle 60d. Require uploads via presigned PUT urls that expire 8h. Manifest file must include filename, sha256, sanitization_level, submitter.
zoe: Good. We also need an RBAC capture script. Asif, can you add a git-backed snapshot process that commits `iam-snapshot-<ts>.json` into a private repo, signs the commit, and outputs the commit SHA into the manifest?
asif: Yep. Script will run `aws iam get-account-authorization-details --output json > iam-snapshot-<ts>.json` then normalize principals -> csv and commit. We'll include the commit SHA and a GPG signature.
sec-bot: [automated] Created ticket SEC-21456: "Vendor pen-test intake: escrow + retest" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-21456
eng-oncall: Bastion plan: create an ephemeral jump host in assessor VPC with no outbound internet. Access via SSM Session Manager only; no SSH key injected. Session recordings stream to `s3://escrow-vuln-4123456780/session-recordings/` and are included in manifest.
peter: For KMS: do not grant kms:Decrypt to assessor roles. Build a decrypt-handler service that runs in a locked subnet and returns only an HMAC + audit_blob. If plaintext is required, sec-ops performs a one-off recorded session and records proof.
zoe: Can someone paste the minimal session policy for assessors? want to validate least-privilege.
asif: minimal session policy (example):
```json
{ "Version":"2012-10-17", "Statement":[ { "Effect":"Allow", "Action":["s3:PutObject"], "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::escrow-vuln-4123456780/*" }, { "Effect":"Allow", "Action":["ssm:StartSession"], "Resource":"arn:aws:ec2:us-west-2:123456789012:instance/*" }, { "Effect":"Allow", "Action":["kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*" } ] }
```
zoe: Perfect. For retest slotting: Peter, propose we award a 4h verification window 72h after a patch rollout. If any gating item missing (evidence, RBAC diff, or signed verification) push by 48h.
peter: Agreed. I'll create a remediation board with columns: reported, in-progress, fixed, evidence-ready, verification. The verification owner must upload `verification.txt` containing their SSO username and timestamp and attach it to the ticket.
asif: Ops notes: will rotate the escrow KMS alias after the engagement. Also enforce bucket policy that denies DeleteObject unless request originates from `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/escrow-admin`.
zoe: Compliance ask: PII must never be included. We will provide sanitized outputs and a redaction checklist. Any raw samples require explicit sec-ops approval and recorded session.
eng-oncall: Canary & rollback: will snapshot SGs, IAM policies, and create a rollback script to revoke assessor roles and isolate the assessor subnet in <5 minutes. We'll rehearse killswitch in a tabletop.
peter: Next steps: 1) asif -> create RBAC snapshot script + escrow bucket terraform; 2) eng-oncall -> canary & rollback runbook; 3) zoe -> evidence redaction checklist + ticket owner; 4) I'll schedule retest windows and publish triage board.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-21456 updated: assignees set to asif, eng-oncall, zoe, peter. Due date set to 2024-11-01.
zoe: Thanks team. We'll do a 48h pre-window check-in in this thread and attach the iam-snapshot commit SHA + manifest hashes before we allow the assessors to start. :white_check_mark:
